title: ProcessIQ organizes workflow evidence so teams can assess change options and plan implementation.
process_step_1: A planning method that combines process records, interviews, observation, and system context to define reviewable workflow options.
A clear view of workflow steps, handoffs, exceptions, and decision points.
A prioritized set of simplify, automate, or redesign options.
Capacity and value hypotheses with transparent assumptions.
A future-state workflow with roles, controls, and measures.
Creates a repeatable evidence-led discovery process.
Connects proposed changes to operating context and controls.
Prepares initiatives for owner and Finance validation.
process_step_2: Register available process records and operating materials.
process_step_3: Map work areas, roles, and handoffs.
process_step_5: Identify delays, rework, and control gaps.
process_step_6: Compare simplify, automate, or redesign choices.
process_step_7: Assess value hypotheses, feasibility, and risk.
process_step_8: Group approved changes into reviewable waves.
